reference_sql:
SELECT store_code,
       SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS revenue_eur,
       SUM(CASE WHEN parent_category = 'Accessories' THEN net_revenue_eur ELSE 0 END) AS accessories_revenue_eur
FROM sales
GROUP BY store_code
alternatives: SELECT store_code, SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS revenue_eur, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN parent_category = 'Accessories' THEN net_revenue_eur END), 0) AS accessories_revenue_eur FROM sales GROUP BY store_code
SELECT store_code, SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS revenue_eur, COALESCE(SUM(net_revenue_eur) FILTER (WHERE parent_category = 'Accessories'), 0) AS accessories_revenue_eur FROM sales GROUP BY 1
